title: Zbtb7a perturbation causes broad mixed neuronal remodeling across thalamic, midbrain, hindbrain, pineal, and Pvalb GABA classes
exact_observed_result: Zbtb7a perturbation generated very large recurrent signatures, including Pnma3 logFC 1.657666563987732 FDR 1.2175148971272107e-41, Col9a3 1.8136500120162964 FDR 1.4451893654129836e-40, Gpc1 0.6908149123191833 FDR 7.01132855322403e-40, and Ppip5k1 -0.5197629928588867 FDR 3.9366301300544587e-20 in 151 TH; Gpc1, Atp1b2, Stx16, and Cacng7 were also FDR-supported in 155 MB; Gpc1 was induced in 217 P MY Pineal. Zbtb18 shared only a small Pxdn/Clstn2/Man2a2 thalamic subset.
biological_interpretation: Zbtb7a perturbation engages a broad mixed neuronal state across selected posterior and inhibitory classes that is much larger than, and only partly overlapping with, Zbtb18/RP58 output.
caveats: The measured Zbtb7a mRNA decrease was weak, so the program is perturbation-associated rather than a clean Zbtb7a transcript dose response.
The Zbtb18 overlap was partial and should not be read as broad ZBTB-family interchangeability.

prior_expectation.summary: Zbtb7a can control promoter accessibility and inducible transcription in a context-dependent manner; Zbtb18/RP58 haploinsufficiency can impair adult cognition and excitatory synaptic maturation
